correctness.rationale: The common-edge-label root decomposition T_n(p)=1+sum_i 1[U_i<p] T_{n,i}(U_i) yields E T=e^{np} and an exact second-moment ODE, solved as f=(2-2/n)e^{2np}+(2p-1+2/n)e^{np}. For p<=q, the additional root-label bins are disjoint, so Cov(T(p),T(q))=Var T(p)-(e^{np}-1)(e^{nq}-e^{np})/n. Factoring gives the one-zero bracket n-1+2np/(e^{np}-1)-e^{n(q-p)}, establishing q_*, sign classification, (log n)/n crossover and correlation limits. With fixed distinct p_j, disjoint-bin Laplace transform (1-sum a_{n,j})^n and the published one-threshold Exp(1) limit yield independent limiting exponentials; the ignored smaller-bin contribution vanishes in L1. Independent evaluation n=2,p=.4 gives q*=.817658752284986 and negative covariance at q=.9. This is an analytic proof; packaged finite-depth simulations are not used as infinite certification.
residual_risks: Published marginal Exp(1) limit is imported correctly; multivariate joint convergence additionally proved by root-bin factorization.
